# [BUG] No fast way to pause the 1-hour cloud idle auto-stop for a scheduled demo/interview

## Bug
Confirmed live 2026-08-20. `.github/workflows/cluster-idle-stop.yml` runs every 10 minutes and stops whichever cloud is running after 1 hour of no gateway traffic (ADR-019). There was no quick, documented way to pause it ahead of a scheduled demo/interview — had to find the workflow by reading the repo and disable it by hand via `gh workflow disable`.

## Root Cause
Missing tooling — the auto-stop mechanism existed but nothing wrapped enabling/disabling it.

## Severity vs. Priority
**Severity (technical impact):** Minor — workaround (`gh workflow disable`) always existed, just undiscoverable.
**Priority (business urgency):** P2

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `infrastructure/scripts/idle-stop-guard.sh <enable|disable|status>` added, wraps `gh workflow enable/disable/list` for "Cluster Idle Auto-Stop" (toggles a GitHub-side flag, not the workflow file — no CI/CD edit, fully reversible)
- [x] `./gradlew idleStopGuard -Paction=disable|enable|status` wired up
- [x] Verified live: idle auto-stop is currently disabled ahead of a scheduled use window

## Notes
Auto-stop is currently OFF (disabled 2026-08-20) to keep the AWS backend up for an interview 2026-08-21 14:00–16:00. Re-enable afterward with `./gradlew idleStopGuard -Paction=enable`.
